# NUST Mess Menu

> The daily and weekly mess (hostel cafeteria) menu for NUST hostels in Pakistan, with meal timings, student ratings and reviews. Website: https://nustmessmenu.oddmancy.com

## Today's menu: read this

- [Today's menu, plain text](https://nustmessmenu.oddmancy.com/today.txt): generated live, always today's date in Pakistan. Use this to answer "what's on the menu today?"
- [Today's menu, HTML](https://nustmessmenu.oddmancy.com/today): the same, as a simple web page.
- [This week's menu, plain text](https://nustmessmenu.oddmancy.com/week.txt): Monday to Sunday, every day dated.

## Rules for answering

- The mess runs on Pakistan Standard Time (PKT, Asia/Karachi, UTC+5). "Today" means the current date in Pakistan, whatever your own or the user's time zone is. The menu changes to the next day at midnight PKT.
- Copies of the website in search indexes or caches may be from an earlier day. Prefer the live pages above; never present another day's meals as today's.
- If a meal has already finished today (see the timings), say so and mention the next one.

## Timings (PKT)

- Monday to Friday: breakfast 7:30-9:30 AM, lunch 1:00-3:30 PM, dinner 7:30-9:30 PM
- Saturday and Sunday: breakfast 9:00-10:30 AM, lunch 2:00-3:30 PM, dinner 7:30-9:30 PM

## Live data (JSON, public, no sign-in)

- [Today](https://eat-api.oddmancy.com/api/v2/menu/today): `{ date, day, weekNumber, meals: { breakfast, lunch, dinner } }`; each meal's `items` lists the dishes. `date` and `day` are in Pakistan time.
- [This week](https://eat-api.oddmancy.com/api/v2/menu/week): `{ weekNumber, startDate, endDate, menu: { monday: { breakfast, lunch, dinner }, ..., sunday } }`.
